info.name: DoorDash Drive Classic Addresses Promotions API
DoorDash Add Promotions for Items at a Store

params.name: store_location_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the store location.

items.docs: Adds item-level promotions for items at a specific store location. Promotions allow partners to set promotional pricing for their items on the DoorDash platform.

info.name: DoorDash Update Promotions for Items at a Store

params.name: store_location_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the store location.

items.docs: Updates existing item-level promotions at a specific store location.
